title: Flowtoro’s Totem of Commands
description: This project replaces the Totem of Undying with the “Totem of Command” (A command block)
body:
This pack gives the command block texture to the Totem of Undying, including:

•Epic-rarity text color\
•Working command block animations\
•A name change for the item

Hope you enjoy!

Thank you to Vira for providing me with ingame screenshots of the pack 🙂

If you need any help with the pack or want to make a suggestion please message **natopotato6075**

**Thank you!**
